Package com.example.linko

Class UserDatabaseHandler

java.lang.Object
com.example.linko.UserDatabaseHandler
public class UserDatabaseHandler extends Object
Handles all the logic for dealing with the user in the Firebase database. Is called whenever we need to use, edit, add, or delete a user within the database
